//: Difficulty presets (docs/gameplay-overhaul/08-difficulty-and-accessibility.md). Each preset's "challenges" gives every kind of challenge its feel on that difficulty, as bounded adjustments to the mechanic's own numbers (src/systems/challenge/difficulty.js, TUNING). They only reach challenges that opted in: every legacy step plays as it always has. "ship" scales Ship Integrity on each difficulty: damage taken, what a repair restores, the materials it costs (rounded up), and "grace" (one blow can't take a section that is still holding straight to nothing; docs/gameplay-overhaul/09-ship-integrity.md); since Prompt 6 also leak inflow, fire growth and spread, and what one pump, bail or douse achieves (docs/gameplay-overhaul/10-flooding-and-fire.md). A profile or a challenge can set any of these itself, and can give each difficulty its own limits, retries and costs ("difficulty": { "brutal": { ... } }).

deckhand.label: Deckhand
deckhand.summary: For the story and the crew. Wider timing windows, more slack, gentler costs and easy retries. Challenges can still go wrong.

captain.label: Captain
captain.summary: The voyage as meant. Timing, preparation and nerve all count, failure has a price, and mashing the button won't save you.

brutal.label: Brutal
brutal.summary: For old salts. Tighter windows, fewer second chances and heavier costs. Hard, never unfair: every challenge can be won.
